title: Chicken Paprikash with Egg Galuska & Cucumber Salad
description: Hungarian classic: chicken thighs braised in a sweet-paprika, pepper and tomato sauce, finished with tejföl, served with egg galuska and a sweet-sour cucumber salad. Hob only, garlic-free.

ingredients.name: Boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets, halved

steps.title: Salt the cucumbers
steps.text: Toss the sliced cucumber with ½ tsp salt and leave 15 min. Squeeze out the liquid, then mix with the vinegar, water and sugar. Chill until serving.

steps.title: Soften the onions
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide lidded pan over medium heat. Cook the onions with a pinch of salt 8 min until soft and golden, not browned.

steps.title: Bloom the paprika off the heat
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the paprika for 1 min — off-heat matters, scorched paprika turns bitter.

steps.title: Add chicken and veg, simmer
steps.text: Back on medium heat, add the chicken, pointed pepper, tomato, stock and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently 25 min until the chicken is tender.

steps.title: Boil the galuska
steps.text: Meanwhile cook the galuska in salted boiling water 8–10 min (check the packet). Drain.

steps.title: Finish with tejföl
steps.text: Whisk the flour into the tejföl, stir in a ladle of the hot sauce to temper it, then pour back into the pan. Simmer uncovered 3 min until thickened — don't boil hard or it can split. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Galuska 90 g dry weight Matthias / 25 g partner; chicken 450 g / 200 g with the sauce over (~65/35); cucumber salad on the side.

notes: No protein bridge needed. Galuska and kápia are standard at Kifli/Spar; if there's no kápia, any red bell pepper works.
